propositions: When Pass-1 produces zero findings, verify_instructions() returns an imperative string with no indices to verify, but the LLM model returns indices [0..N-1], causing all to be marked unexpected and the contract to be violated.
The empty-batch path creates a mismatch between sent index domain (empty) and returned indices, triggering a verification contract violation that degrades all findings to INDETERMINATE.
INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot cause a BLOCK decision and are silently absorbed if any advisory surfaces, so affected runs show correct PASS verdicts despite being unverified.
The fix changes verify_instructions() to return an explicit empty verifications instruction for zero-finding batches, eliminating the index-basis mismatch.
Regression test test_verify_empty_batch_contract.py reproduces the contract violation before the fix and passes after, covering the empty-batch path that cannot be reliably triggered in production.
